Lineage II: BASIC — New Details on Progression, Equipment & Starter Package
With the October 28 launch approaching, NCSOFT has shared more details about BASIC's equipment systems, character progression, and monetization.
Equipment & Removed Systems
D-Grade Equipment: Weapons and armor are intended to remain valuable for an extended period. Equipment obtained through hunting or NPC shops will generally be tradable.
Removed Systems: Circlet, Mask, Pendant, and Gem Slots, along with Dyes, Potential, Dolls, and Collections, have been removed to simplify progression and reduce the gap between players.
Some of these systems may return in future updates, integrated into regular gameplay and character progression.
Character Progression & Hunting
Early Progression: Leveling will initially focus on tutorial quests. After the 3rd Class Transfer, progression will become slower and primarily hunting-based.
Field Hunting: Hunting zones will be available up to Dragon Valley, with additional areas planned for future updates.
Dungeons & Group Content: Tower of Insolence will offer increasingly difficult encounters on higher floors. Raids and other cooperative activities will also be available.
Starter Package
A paid Starter Package will be available to support early character progression.
Price: 29,700 KRW
Purchase Limit: Once per account

Lineage II: BASIC — Overlord: Bartz Skills Preview
NCSOFT has released a new video showcasing 12 skills of the upcoming Overlord: Bartz class, including their effects and combat mechanics.
Skills & Effects
Luminous Edge: Attacks the target twice and stacks the Gwanghon debuff.
Luminous Walk: Dashes toward the target, attacking twice and stacking Gwanghon.
Radiant Cutter: Catalyst: Attacks enemies along its path twice. Increases Breaking Veil's Defense Ignore when used immediately afterward.
Breaking Veil: Attacks enemies, reduces their Dagger Resistance, and grants Atk. Spd. and Dagger Damage bonuses. Can apply 2 Gwanghon stacks.
Radiant Dive: Catalyst: Leaps onto enemies, attacking twice. Triggers additional strikes against Gwanghon-affected targets and reduces the Dagger Resistance of the enemy with the lowest current HP.
Blinding Spectrum: Throws daggers to attack enemies twice, applying Occlusion (obstructed vision?), followed by Obscure (reduced P./ M. Accuracy).
Ambient Knifestorm: Powerful two-hit AoE attack. Enchanting the skill increases its power and number of hits.
Distortion: Increases Evasion and Resistance, granting 3 Shell stacks. Consumes Gwanghon stacks from nearby enemies to gain additional Shell stacks, which help avoid debuffs and crowd-control effects.
Lumitrix: Greatly increases offensive capabilities. Activates additional strikes when attacking and automatic counterattacks when receiving damage.
Ramsheart: Attacks enemies in front and grants defensive buffs to nearby allies and the caster. Requires the Lumitrix: Chromatic state.
Trace Link: Attacking Gwanghon-affected targets applies Glottal Slit, sealing their Physical Skills.
Lucent Screen: Has a chance to activate Mirroring when hit, reflecting a portion of incoming damage.

Lineage II KR — Paid Mail & Adena Exchange Removal
Starting October 28, 2026, the following changes will take effect on Korean servers:
Mail System
Paid Mail will be removed.
Unclaimed sent mail containing attached items will be returned to the sender's Personal Warehouse, including attachments and any L-Coin/Adena fees paid.
World Trade
Adena Exchange will be removed.
All registered items (including fees paid), expired listings, and pending sale proceeds will be transferred to the character's Personal Warehouse.

Lineage II: BASIC — A Closer Look at Overlord: Bartz
Read the full article
We've published a new article covering the latest details revealed about Overlord: Bartz, the new dual-dagger class arriving with Lineage II: BASIC on October 28.
NCSOFT has showcased 12 representative skills, giving us a better look at the class's combat mechanics:
Mastery & Passives: Dagger specialization, critical damage bonuses, Afterimage effects, and defensive mechanics.
Attack Skills: Fast-paced combat, AoE attacks, mobility, Defense Ignore, and debuffs.
Buffs & Reactions: Offensive enhancements, debuff avoidance, and automatic counterattacks.
We also explore how Bartz's combat style might fit into BASIC's progression-focused environment, along with what's still unknown ahead of launch.
